items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And Joe writes down, he says, I sold my half to Phil Kornheiser and Feist.

ctx.x: I love Don't Leave Me Daddy.

Well, that was one of them. Jimmy Dupree wrote Jelly Bean, too, you remember? And he used to work for Feist. Joe goes up to New York and Jimmy and I were sitting around the Elks Club in New Orleans there and we wrote a number. My cozy little blue room. In a cozy little blue room. And it was similar on a show type number. And Joe writes down, he says, I sold my half to Phil Kornheiser and Feist. What you all gonna do with your half? Two more of us, our half. He sold his half. Jimmy said, the nerve of him. How big…
